title: ChatGPT
text: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT as a research preview, bringing conversational AI to a broad public audience.

title: GPT-4
text: GPT-4 introduces a new generation of capabilities for complex language tasks and image inputs.

title: Llama 2
text: Meta releases Llama 2 with downloadable weights and a license permitting commercial use subject to its terms.

title: Mixtral 8x7B
text: Mistral publishes downloadable weights for Mixtral 8x7B, a mixture-of-experts language model, under Apache 2.0.

title: Claude 3 family
text: Anthropic announces Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus: a family of models spanning different speed and capability needs.

title: Llama 3
text: Meta introduces Llama 3 and uses the model family to power its Meta AI assistant.

title: Phi-3 mini
text: Microsoft introduces Phi-3 mini, a small language model with publicly available weights intended for deployment where compute resources are limited.

title: GPT-4o
text: OpenAI introduces GPT-4o, a model designed to work across text, vision, and audio.

title: Qwen2
text: The Qwen team releases pretrained and instruction-tuned models in several sizes. Downloadable weights are available; licensing varies by model variant.

title: Gemma 2
text: Google releases Gemma 2 in 9B and 27B sizes with downloadable weights for research and development, subject to Gemma license terms.

title: DeepSeek-V3
text: DeepSeek releases V3, a mixture-of-experts language model with downloadable weights and hosted API access. Deployment and use are governed by its model terms.

title: DeepSeek-R1
text: DeepSeek releases the R1 reasoning model and distilled variants. Weights are available for local deployment; check the terms of the selected variant.

title: Gemma 3
text: Google releases Gemma 3 in several sizes, including text-and-image models. Downloadable weights support deployment on local hardware, subject to Gemma terms.

title: Gemini 2.5 Pro experimental
text: Google releases an experimental Gemini 2.5 Pro model with thinking enabled, accessed through Google services rather than downloadable weights.

title: Llama 4 Scout / Maverick
text: Meta releases Llama 4 Scout and Maverick, multimodal models with downloadable weights and a mixture-of-experts architecture, under the Llama license.

title: Qwen3
text: The Qwen team releases dense and mixture-of-experts models with thinking and non-thinking modes. The released open-weight models use Apache 2.0.

title: Phi-4 reasoning
text: Microsoft releases Phi-4 reasoning models with downloadable weights, focused on mathematical, scientific, and other reasoning tasks.

title: Claude 4
text: Anthropic introduces Claude Opus 4 and Sonnet 4, with a focus on coding, reasoning, and agent workflows.

title: gpt-oss 20B / 120B
text: OpenAI releases gpt-oss-20b and gpt-oss-120b, downloadable reasoning models under Apache 2.0. They can be run on independently managed infrastructure.

title: GPT-5
text: OpenAI introduces GPT-5 in ChatGPT and the API, combining fast responses with deeper reasoning for more demanding tasks.

title: Gemini 3 Pro preview
text: Google begins rolling out Gemini 3 Pro to the Gemini app and developer services. This milestone marks the preview release.

title: Mistral Large 3 / Ministral 3
text: Mistral introduces Large 3 and the Ministral 3 family, with downloadable weights under Apache 2.0. The release spans different model sizes and deployment needs.

title: Qwen3.5
text: The Qwen team announces Qwen3.5, including the open-weight Qwen3.5-397B-A17B multimodal model. Hosted Qwen offerings and downloadable variants should be distinguished.

title: Gemini 3.1 Pro preview
text: Google introduces Gemini 3.1 Pro in preview for reasoning, coding, and agent workflows through its hosted services.

title: GPT-5.4
text: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4 in ChatGPT, the API, and Codex, focusing on professional work, coding, and computer use.

title: Mistral Small 4
text: Mistral releases Small 4 with reasoning, multimodal, and coding capabilities in one model. Weights are available under Apache 2.0.

title: Gemma 4
text: Google introduces Gemma 4 for reasoning and agent workflows, making the model family available under Apache 2.0.

title: GPT-5.5
text: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.5 for complex work on computers, including coding, research, and tasks that require using multiple tools.

title: DeepSeek-V4 preview
text: DeepSeek introduces V4-Pro and V4-Flash preview models. The V4-Pro model card provides downloadable weights and deployment information.

title: Qwen3.8-27B
text: The Qwen team publishes Qwen3.8-27B with downloadable model weights and instructions for local deployment.

title: GPT-6 Astra
text: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Astra, a new model generation for demanding reasoning and work across software environments.

title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
text: DeepSeek introduces V4.1-Flash with native image and text input support. Downloadable weights are available under the MIT license, alongside hosted API access.

title: Claude Opus 5.5
text: Anthropic introduces Opus 5.5, the first Claude 5.5 model, targeting complex tasks that require careful judgment.

title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
text: Anthropic releases Sonnet 5.5 as a faster, lower-cost model for everyday tasks, bug fixes, and creating documents, slides, and spreadsheets.

title: GPT-6.1 Sol
text: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Sol at DevDay 2026, making it available in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API for coding and professional work.

title: GPT-6 in ChatGPT
text: OpenAI begins rolling out GPT-6 in ChatGPT's Chat tab with Intelligent UI, enabling answers that include interactive interfaces and visual tools.

title: Claude Haiku 5.5
text: Anthropic introduces Haiku 5.5, a small model designed for fast, high-volume, cost-sensitive applications.
